features.mutations: Creates or resumes owner configuration and authentication state.
features.success: The owner reaches authenticated, configured state.
features.failure: Setup or authentication errors remain visible.
features.recovery: Resume interrupted setup or reauthenticate a recent owner.
features.keyboard_focus: Wizard choices use the shared radio model; the dialog traps focus and returns it on exit.

features.mutations: Captures work and persists Home display preferences where enabled.
features.success: Captured work is visible and registered workbenches open.
features.failure: Local notices retain failure or offline state.
features.recovery: Retry is explicit where a Home section fails.
features.keyboard_focus: Shell navigation and capture are keyboard-operable with focus return.

authority_guards: owner-approved tool and Full Access boundaries
features.mutations: Creates conversations, projects, memories, delegated work, and approved local executions.
features.success: A completed run exposes its conclusion and retained audit controls.
features.failure: Provider and policy failures remain visible without exposing secrets.
features.recovery: Retry or continue only through the existing approval boundary.
features.keyboard_focus: Chat, work panel, menus, and dialogs use the shared keyboard/focus contract.
gaps: Live model-backed Auto completion is externally blocked without disposable provider credentials.

authority_guards: two-to-five choices and optional free text
features.mutations: Persists an answer or cancellation for the durable question.
features.success: Pointer or keyboard answer resumes the retained task after reload.
features.failure: Invalid or unavailable delivery is shown without silently answering.
features.recovery: Reload/reattach continues the same question; cancellation is durable.
features.keyboard_focus: Choices and free text are keyboard-operable.
gaps: Live Discord delivery is externally blocked without disposable bot credentials.

features.mutations: Searches and optionally records a verification request; opening citations leaves Alles.
features.success: Links-first results and citations render separately from an answer.
features.failure: Unavailable model or failed checks are rendered honestly.
features.recovery: Retry preserves the query path where available.
features.keyboard_focus: Search modal and result controls follow shared dialog/focus behavior.
gaps: Compact answer and independent verifier need disposable model credentials.

features.mutations: Creates, moves, edits, completes, and deletes task/calendar records.
features.success: Atomic task moves and calendar changes are reflected in the workbench.
features.failure: Validation or persistence errors remain visible.
features.recovery: History/details preserve a route back from failed editing.
features.keyboard_focus: Board navigation is keyboard-operable.

features.mutations: Sends mail and edits contact records through configured connectors.
features.success: Configured connector work updates cached mail or contacts.
features.failure: Connector failure is visible and does not claim delivery.
features.recovery: Retry depends on restoring the configured external connector.
features.keyboard_focus: Registered Inbox roots use the shared custom-control contract.
gaps: Live mailbox and address-book scenarios require disposable external accounts.

features.mutations: Creates, edits, renames, restores, migrates, and rolls back documents and journal entries.
features.success: Edits recover across reload; rename preserves backlinks; migration can roll back.
features.failure: Conflicts and failed edits remain explicit.
features.recovery: Draft/reload recovery and rollback are available.
features.keyboard_focus: Editor and dialogs have focused keyboard coverage.

features.mutations: Browses, copies, moves, rolls back, and organizes owner-approved files and media.
features.success: Selected location operations and Gallery return paths retain context.
features.failure: Offline and conflict state is explicit.
features.recovery: Rollback and conflict recovery are offered for safe operations.
features.keyboard_focus: Workbench dialogs and navigation return focus.

authority_guards: owner-selected feeds and local reading/book records
features.mutations: Saves reading, updates books, runs and explicitly saves a news brief.
features.success: Saved content and cited briefs appear in their destination.
features.failure: Independently successful data stays visible when a source fails.
features.recovery: Explicit retry is available for failed loading paths.
features.keyboard_focus: Library controls use the shared contract.

features.mutations: Records synthetic or owner-entered observations and habit completion.
features.success: Observation and habit changes render without medical claims.
features.failure: Partial and empty summaries remain distinguishable.
features.recovery: Retry preserves independently loaded data.
features.keyboard_focus: Health controls use the shared contract.

authority_guards: read-only import provenance and conflict controls
features.mutations: Previews/applies statement imports and undoes imports with provenance.
features.success: Ledger/import authority and undo state remain visible.
features.failure: Conflicts fail closed without silently changing canonical data.
features.recovery: Undo/retry use the retained import identity.
features.keyboard_focus: Finance row actions and controls use shared semantics.
gaps: Live disposable Actual service is unavailable for reconciliation acceptance.

features.mutations: Connects, reconnects, disconnects, revokes, and deduplicates imported connector data.
features.success: Consent and connector state are retained with provenance.
features.failure: Unsupported or unavailable connection is explicit.
features.recovery: Reconnect or revoke requires the external provider boundary.
features.keyboard_focus: No dedicated control root is registered; use the parent Finance surface.

features.mutations: Pairs, fills selected credentials, locks, and revokes browser authority.
features.success: Only the selected exact-site credential is released; it is never submitted.
features.failure: Mismatched/broader authority is rejected.
features.recovery: Lock, restart, computer lock, or revoke removes fill authority.
features.keyboard_focus: Vault controls use shared custom-control behavior.

features.mutations: Inspects owned resources and requests service, policy, watch, or update changes.
features.success: Permitted inspection or lifecycle state is rendered with audit context.
features.failure: Unsafe policy edits are rejected.
features.recovery: Update rollback restores prior selection and focus.
features.keyboard_focus: Server controls and rollback flows preserve focus.
gaps: Live owned disposable restart and rollback targets are unavailable.

features.mutations: Prepares a companion and, only after preflight, can activate or roll back DNS.
features.success: Prepare does not activate the service.
features.failure: Unsupported or unsafe activation remains unavailable.
features.recovery: DNS rollback is required after activation.
features.keyboard_focus: No dedicated control root is registered; use the parent Server surface.
gaps: Activation and statistics require a disposable VM or isolated network.

authority_guards: pinned companion ownership and rollback controls
features.mutations: Prepares a companion and manages proxy/certificate/access lifecycle only when prerequisites pass.
features.success: Prepare-without-start preserves the inactive boundary.
features.failure: Missing Docker or unsafe activation is explicit.
features.recovery: Service rollback is required after activation.
features.keyboard_focus: No dedicated control root is registered; use the parent Server surface.
gaps: Live proxy activation requires a disposable Docker VM or isolated network.

authority_guards: signed webhook and explicit health/revocation boundary
features.mutations: Pairs, connects, tests, disconnects, and revokes owner connectors.
features.success: Connector health and revocation state are explicit.
features.failure: External delivery failure does not claim success.
features.recovery: Reconnect/revoke remains owner-controlled.
features.keyboard_focus: No dedicated control root is registered; Settings owns the visible controls.
gaps: Real connector pairing and delivery need disposable credentials/endpoints.

features.mutations: Connects, refreshes, discovers, or revokes provider credentials.
features.success: Supported auth type and provider state are shown accurately.
features.failure: Unsupported OAuth is shown honestly.
features.recovery: Refresh/revoke uses provider-specific flow.
features.keyboard_focus: Settings keyboard and overflow behavior has focused coverage.
gaps: Live OAuth/API-key acceptance needs disposable credentials.

features.mutations: Creates, pauses, resumes, retries, cancels, and audits schedules and automation actions.
features.success: Completed action state and audit history are retained.
features.failure: Failed or uncertain external action stays visible; uncertain work is not auto-retried.
features.recovery: Pause/resume, retry, and cancellation are explicit.
features.keyboard_focus: Scheduled controls use custom controls.

features.mutations: Selects automatic or explicit language, region, timezone, clock, week, and currency preferences.
features.success: Overrides survive restart.
features.failure: Catalog failure is explicit without corrupting existing choices.
features.recovery: Reopen Settings and retain the last persisted choice.
features.keyboard_focus: Settings custom controls are keyboard-operable.

features.mutations: Searches and opens attribution/notice detail; it does not mutate owner data.
features.success: Available local notices and evidence render.
features.failure: Unavailable notice is stated honestly.
features.recovery: Search or reopen detail without side effects.
features.keyboard_focus: Settings search/detail uses the shared contract.

features.mutations: No product record mutation; governs control behavior across surfaces.
features.success: Custom controls remain keyboard-operable with focus return and visible state.
features.failure: Contract violations must fail deterministic tests.
features.recovery: Restore focus, preserve visible content, and retry through the owning feature.
features.keyboard_focus: This feature is the cross-application keyboard/focus authority.

features.mutations: Installs/caches the PWA and pairs, unlocks, matches, fills, locks, or revokes the extension.
features.success: Offline shell and paired extension boundaries are explicit.
features.failure: Unavailable install/device capability remains visible.
features.recovery: Reconnect, lock, or revoke removes stale authority.
features.keyboard_focus: Extension controls retain keyboard coverage where rendered.
gaps: Installed PWA and packaged mobile acceptance require an external install/device target.

authority_guards: encrypted backup and recovery key boundary
features.mutations: Creates/restores backups and stages, accepts, rolls back, or uninstalls lifecycle state.
features.success: Verified lifecycle work preserves owner data and records recovery state.
features.failure: Unknown process, dirty code, or unsafe restore fails closed.
features.recovery: Interrupted update and restore flows are resumable/rollback-aware.
features.keyboard_focus: No dedicated control root is registered; Server owns visible lifecycle controls.
gaps: Fresh Linux VM lifecycle acceptance needs a disposable VM.

features.mutations: Issues/revokes scoped API tokens and executes permitted CLI/API/shell/code actions.
features.success: Permitted interface output respects the configured scope.
features.failure: Scope escalation is rejected.
features.recovery: Revoke or reissue through the scoped authority.
features.keyboard_focus: No dedicated control root is registered; Server/settings surfaces own visible controls.
